punchline: As his factory burned, Edison told his son to fetch his mother, because she'd never see a fire like it again.
thirty_sec: In December 1914, fire destroyed much of Thomas Edison's West Orange complex, with much of it uninsured. Edison was 67. His son Charles found him calmly watching and was told: 'Go get your mother and all her friends. They'll never see a fire like this again.' Edison began rebuilding immediately and was producing again within weeks. Ryan Holiday uses it to show acceptance followed by action.
